alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one anonymous slider produces a reproducible change in final shape, scale-free scalar geometry, bead parametrization, or iterations-to-convergence above preregistered numerical noise.
assumptions: The actual KnotPlot executable runtime parameter dump is authoritative for numerical defaults and sector parameter names.
reset all selects the documented damped default dynamics; collision fast enforces collision avoidance / No Collide.
Only the sector associated with the currently tested slider is explicitly enabled; unrelated controls remain at reset-all state.
No fitto, close, max-dr, stusplit, dstep or time increment override is allowed in the scientific campaign.
The 300-bead catalogue trefoil must be safe under the runtime defaults; otherwise the campaign fails closed rather than rescaling the seed.
edge_cases: Exact-zero endpoints are excluded from logarithmic/quadratic fits.
A zero runtime default makes multiplicative default-relative sweeping undefined and fails install calibration.
Safety-cap termination is diagnostic non-convergence, not convergence at the cap.
A slider may change convergence time strongly while leaving final geometry nearly invariant.

equations.dimensional_check: Logarithm argument and result are dimensionless.
Ratio of equal-length quantities is dimensionless.

inputs: iterations-to-convergence at multiplier m and sector reference

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any registered setter/sector command is rejected or not reflected in the runtime parameter state.
The trefoil is not safe under reset-all defaults plus collision-fast; no rescaling is permitted in v0.2.2.
No anonymous slider produces shape, scalar or convergence-time response above the registered numerical noise floors.
One or more conditions fail to reach the adaptive plateau before the safety cap or finish unsafe.

null_hypothesis: H0: after correct runtime application and adaptive convergence, none of the seven anonymous slider sweeps produces a response above preregistered numerical noise relative to its sector-matched default reference.
objective: Measure one-slider-at-a-time default-relative response curves on an exact quarter-octave ladder without prescribing a fixed final relaxation count; distinguish shape effects, parametrization effects and convergence-timescale effects.

observables.definition: Final default-relative normalized shape response for every anonymous slider condition.
Edge-spacing coefficient of variation used to separate parametrization response from embedded-shape response.
Campaign completeness, command/state verification and final-safety status.

predictions: Amplitude-like sliders may primarily alter final geometry magnitude; exponent-like sliders may change response-law shape.
A predominantly tangential redistribution control may change edge-spacing statistics more strongly than arclength-resampled embedded shape.
A S6-like convergence control may change N_conv more strongly than final D_shape.
research_question: For one catalogue trefoil in the Damped + No-Collide regime, how does each of seven anonymous GUI slider parameters change the adaptively converged geometry or convergence timescale relative to the slider default, while all unrelated controls remain at reset-all defaults?

steps.operation: Runtime-probe all seven anonymous slider parameters and five sector switches, verify assignment-form setters, verify Damped reset default plus collision-fast regime, and export exactly one safe trefoil during installation.
Generate five sector-matched default reference conditions and seven default-relative sweeps on the exact quarter-octave ladder plus exact-zero endpoint.
For every condition stream small go-quantum blocks into one persistent KnotPlot process and stop by the preregistered geometry/scalar plateau rule rather than a fixed final iteration count.
Compute final shape, scale-free scalar, parametrization and convergence-time responses against the matching sector reference.
Certify coordinate-derived scalar metrics with C++17/pybind11 FP64 against Python FP64.
Report the anonymous tangential-sector response as parametrization-versus-shape and the anonymous S6 sector response as convergence-timescale-versus-final-shape diagnostics.
After commitment-verified reveal only, attach GUI slider and sector names to the frozen anonymous response curves.

number of KnotPlot iterations required by adaptive plateau criterion
